ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, a horizontal dashed line marks the four points M, A, B, and N in sequence from left to right; +Q is marked at M, −Q is marked at N, and A and B are located on the line connecting the two charges between them. The problem gives MA=AB=BN. Then reason: Let MA=AB=BN=d. At point A, the direction of the electric field of +Q on A is to the right along the line, and its magnitude is kQ/d^2; the direction of the electric field of −Q on A is also to the right, and since AN=2d, its magnitude is kQ/(2d)^2=kQ/(4d^2), so E_A=kQ/d^2+kQ/(4d^2), direction to the right. At point B, the distance from +Q to B is BM=2d, the electric field on B is to the right, and its magnitude is kQ/(4d^2); the distance from −Q to B is BN=d, the electric field on B is also to the right, and its magnitude is kQ/d^2, so E_B=kQ/(4d^2)+kQ/d^2, direction to the right. Therefore, the electric field strengths at points A and B have equal magnitudes and the same direction.

method.method_draft: 先读图：M在左端标有+Q，N在右端标有−Q，A、B位于二者连线上且在两电荷之间，顺序为M-A-B-N。再读题：两点电荷等量异种，且MA=AB=BN。设每段长度为d。用点电荷场强公式和叠加原理计算：在A点，+Q产生的场强方向向右，大小kQ/d^2；−Q产生的场强方向也向右，距离为AN=2d，大小kQ/(2d)^2，所以E_A= kQ/d^2 + kQ/(4d^2)，方向向右。在B点，+Q产生的场强方向向右，距离BM=2d，大小kQ/(4d^2)；−Q产生的场强方向向右，距离BN=d，大小kQ/d^2，所以E_B= kQ/(4d^2)+kQ/d^2，方向向右。两者大小和方向都相同，因此A、B两点场强相同。
